# The Deep Lantern

*A squid as long as a ship has found the way in under the headland to the sea-hole in the Holm Wood, and rises there at night among its lights. Fight it from the ledges round the rim; when its ink falls, read where it is from its lights. Potions work in the Lantern Deep; scrolls do not.*
